currentRoundInspection.scope: Three useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only; no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected2017 front: warm stone twin square towers with single/paired pointed openings, smaller upper stages and unequal pyramidal crowns; left crown has interlaced arcade fringe, right main block/crown has battlements. Central facade has two rows of blind arcades and a central round-headed window, not a rose. Three pointed open porch arches sit beneath a flat terrace/cornice; closed door behind. Broad front steps and two sculptural gate piers. Exact sculpture/ironwork excluded.

Inspected2017 east: very tall pale central round apse with shallow roof, vertical colonnettes and pointed blind arcade under cornice; lower flanking apses, tall square corner buttress walls and a high decorated transverse block. Main central and side apses carry large pointed windows; trees hide some lower surfaces. No baked age/soot patches or bespoke sculpture.

Inspected elevated1997 view: red-tiled raised nave and lower aisle roofs, gray semi-cylindrical transverse barrel roof, taller pitched choir and large central apse with two lower flank apses. Unequal tower crowns, smaller upper blocks, pointed side windows/cornices and separate northern cloister courtyard/ranges visible. Adjacent cloister/urban ranges remain host buildings. Ground levels/older roof state are approximate; current later restoration details not independently verified.
